prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
No clear effect was seen for spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, playful starter hubs, carousel path layouts, desktop overlay waiting hints, account persistence verification, desktop visibility prompts, and estimated generation time indicators.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, and path choice flexibility reassurance copy performed worse than control.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, pre-adoption photo prep screens, and all changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Naming Companion Creation Screen: Inserts a dedicated companion naming screen right before the adoption certificate generation step. (why: Adoption has a 75.3% conversion rate and takes a median of 89s; giving the pet a name early increases user attachment.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Archetype Quick Selector Flow: Adds an archetype preference screen before path selection to help users choose between custom or pre-made pet styles. (why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s; filtering options by archetype accelerates user choice.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Activity Sneak Peek Sound Carousel: Adds an audio and activity preview component to the waiting screen during generation. (why: The waiting phase has a long mean time of 2336s; interactive previews maintain user engagement while waiting.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Dock Placement Guidance Banner: Updates the home intro screen copy with clear instructions on finding the pet on the desktop or tray. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets not showing on the desktop or failing to open, while finish conversion is 64.8%.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Immersive Companion Introduction Story Card: Revises story screen intro copy to set clear expectations on what desktop pets do before path choice. (why: Choose path takes a mean duration of 514s; framing user expectations early reduces initial hesitation.)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Companion Hatching Progress Bar: Displays an animated hatching progress bar and pet sprite preview on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s; visual progress feedback keeps users from quitting during background rendering.)

scores.note: Target step drops ~25% users, but adding pre-adoption screens extra steps historically shows minimal gain (+0.7%).
Addresses high choice duration (514s); pet style and archetype selectors previously beat predictions.
Target step drops 13.6% with long 2336s wait; wait_info changes consistently average around +3.1% lift.
High impact step (35.2% loss) with support ticket evidence, but finish copy changes previously degraded conversion.

Interactive progress displays strongly align with lessons where progress carousels boosted engagement during rendering.
